adhan_settings.title: Adhan Notifications
adhan_settings.description: Get notified with Adhan call at each prayer time. The app will play the Adhan sound when prayer time arrives.
adhan_settings.permission_required: Permission required. Please allow notifications in system settings.
adhan_settings.info_note: Adhan will play automatically at prayer times even when the app is closed. Make sure your device allows notifications.
